title: Anth.us-Papyrus: port the Anth.us site onto Papyrus (dogfooding) - coordinating issue
description:
Umbrella for the Anth.us -> Papyrus/Markus port started 2026-10-03. Goal: Anthus dogfoods its own CMS by rebuilding anth.us as a Papyrus/Markus static reader site at FULL design and content parity.

== WHAT EXISTS ==
REPO  AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus - PRIVATE on purpose (half-finished port of a live marketing site; one click to flip). Default branch develop.
      Local: /Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-Papyrus
      PR #1 feature/anthus-papyrus-port -> develop   (scaffold, chrome, build)
      PR #2 feature/markus-native-content-and-citations -> feature/anthus-papyrus-port  (content directive integration)
STAGING  Amplify app d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, branch 'staging', platform WEB, account 335163751677 (AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1)
      https://staging.d2hbn1ig6nqyhy.amplifyapp.com
      Guards VERIFIED live: noindex meta on every page, robots.txt Disallow: /, X-Robots-Tag: noindex. DO NOT REGRESS.
      Zero domain associations. Production anth.us stays on Gatsby until Ryan reviews. NO DNS/Route53 work.
CONTENT  Consumed as a submodule from AnthusAI/anthus-site-content - the SAME repo the live Gatsby site builds from. One source of truth.
      PR #18 content/markus-native-markup -> main  (the MDX -> Markus codemod)
      *** DO NOT MERGE #18 until anth.us is actually cut over from Gatsby. *** Converted markup does not render in Gatsby. The reader site tracks it as a submodule BRANCH, so it never needs to merge early. main is at 4b80f02 and must stay untouched.
PAPYRUS  PR #83 feature/markus-responsive-images-and-citations -> develop
      Adds src/papyrus_content/markus_renderer/images.py (responsive image pipeline, GatsbyImage equivalent) and citations.py (inline [@key] + ::citations{} bibliography, CSL-JSON in front matter). Spec: docs/markus-content-markup.md. Also adds publications/anth_us/ (anthUsBrand SiteBrand, theme.css) and ANTH_US_THEME_PACK_TOKENS in lib/site-stack.ts.

== AUTHORING SYNTAX CONTRACT (from PR #83, docs/markus-content-markup.md) ==
  <BlogImage images={..} name="chart.png" className="full" alt="A chart" />  ->  ::image{src="images/chart.png" layout="full" alt="A chart"}
  <Citation data={{...}} />        ->  front-matter citations: <key>: <CSL-JSON>  +  inline [@key]
  <CitationsList />                ->  ::citations{format="apa"}
::image{} accepts src (required), alt, layout, caption, credit, sizes, loading. ANY other attribute is a hard build error, and markus convert fails the WHOLE page on an unregistered directive - this is why converted content cannot deploy before #83 lands.

== MERGE ORDER - GETS THIS WRONG AND STAGING BREAKS ==
  1. Papyrus #83 -> develop
  2. Bump PAPYRUS_PIN in Anth.us-Papyrus amplify.yml (currently d0b00b3, which LACKS #83)
  3. Anth.us-Papyrus #2
  4. Deploy staging
  5. Content #18 only at real cutover
amplify.yml checks out PAPYRUS_PIN by commit SHA, so a SHA on a pushed branch is fetchable - that is the escape hatch for previewing unmerged Papyrus work on staging. Any such temporary pin must be flagged in-file and reverted to a develop SHA.

== OPEN WORK (see child issues filed by the wind-down) ==
A. EXACT DESIGN PARITY - the big one. The port rendered Anthus content in MARKUS'S design language, not the Anthus design. The two sites share ZERO CSS class names (old: index-module--listItem--06e6d, blog-post-preview, gatsby-image-wrapper, clear-float; new: markus-card, markus-document, markus-site-masthead). Old site = 33KB SCSS -> 26,104-byte compiled bundle; new site was a hand-written 12,241-byte anthus-theme.css. Ryan: 'We want the front end design to be exactly the same as the old site', and then 'Yes, fix Markus' - i.e. where Markus's markup blocks parity, FIX MARKUS UPSTREAM rather than working around it in the site build, keeping changes publication-neutral.
   GROUND TRUTH for parity: /Users/home/Projects/Anth.us/public/ is a real Gatsby build (2026-09-24) - 243 rendered HTML pages + styles.04b540856f53bb5e70f2.css. Treat as precious reference.
B. URL PARITY - Ryan: '/articles/ canonical, but support redirects from /blog/ for backward compatibility with articles already published.' Production serves directory-style URLs: /blog/<slug>/ AND bare /<slug>/ both 200, /about/ 200. The port serves /articles/<slug>.html and /about.html, with /about/ and /blog/<slug>/ 302-ing to 404. UNRESOLVED: whether canonical should be directory-style (/articles/<slug>/) or .html - Ryan settled the namespace, not the shape; directory-style was an inference and needs his confirmation.
C. Six known design gaps: <mark> (204 uses) flattened to bold; hero overlay stacked not overlaid; priority-plus nav replaced with a breakpoint hamburger; 2 inline SVGs dropped; table colspan/rowspan flattened; anthus-footer (a separate GitHub package) hand-reproduced as markup. Analytics deliberately omitted.
D. corpora/anth-us-{steering,newsroom-sections,analysis-profiles}.yml are referenced by publications/anth_us/brand.ts but were never created; newsroom workflows for the brand will not run until they exist.
E. AVIF never observed working (local Pillow has avif: False, silently falls back to webp). Image widths capped at 1366 because the pipeline always emits the source format as the <picture> fallback and this corpus is photographic PNG - a JPEG fallback for photographic sources is the real fix, flagged Papyrus-side.
F. APA bibliography was never diffed against the live Gatsby output. The formatter is hand-rolled, not citeproc; all 197 entries format without error. Known weak spot: content where 'author' holds several people in one string.

== HARD-WON GOTCHAS ==
- Papyrus's _ARTICLE_SLUG silently DROPS any slug containing capitals. 'Paytronix' staged but never rendered - a missing page with a successful build. Fixed in the port; worth fixing upstream.
- Pilobol.us is a LIVE production site building against the same Markus module. Any Markus change must leave its output byte-identical: build its pod from an isolated /tmp copy (its real build script rewrites content front matter in place) against both develop and the branch, then diff -r. Expected: 89 files identical. PR #83 verified this.
- AWS_PROFILE=legacy is the ONLY working route to account 335163751677. The [profile anthus] entry points at the same account via an expired non-SSO login_session; testing it reports 'session has expired' and makes the account look unreachable. See PPY-5e3a67.
- Prior agents repeatedly asserted fidelity from HTML/CSS inspection WITHOUT rendering anything. That is how a port ends up with zero class names in common and nobody noticing. Require screenshot comparison against Anth.us/public/ before believing any parity claim.
